sentences.text: Notice be made returnable within eight weeks.
It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner that the accident has occurred on 17.12.2023 and the amendment has been brought in the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, with effect from April 2022.

It is submitted that the learned court below has directed the petitioner company to pay the compensation and then recover it on the basis of pay and recover, which is not available after the amendment in the Act of 1988.

Considering the submissions of the petitioner and on perusal of the findings of the court below, the operation of the impugned award dated 25.6.2025 passed by Additional M.A.C.T. Jaisingh Nagar,
District Shahdol in MACC No.4/2024 shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing subject to deposit of 100% amount of compensation in fixed deposit in a nationalized bank under the order of the Tribunal.
The 2 CR-947-2025 amount so deposited by the petitioner shall not be disbursed without the leave of this court.

(DEEPAK KHOT) JUDGE HS Zurich Kotak Mahindra Gen. Insu. Co. ... vs Sandhya Kushwah on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78777211/
